purpose: The pack's focus language applied to one control: ring, glow or lift, with one scale and one radius. Every focusable surface calls Focus.attach, so a plate, a row and a card cannot disagree.

anatomy.note: Outset keyline in the pack's focus colour (ring style).
Soft accent bloom plus a keyline (glow style).
Scale and shadow, no outline (lift style).

rules: Focus is always visible; never colour-only.
The focused control is the only one that grows.

behaviour: Scale and duration come from tokens; a pack cannot invent a new focus animation in a screen.

platformDeltas.ios: Use the platform focus effect on tvOS and a visible keyline on touch-first iOS.
platformDeltas.windows: Focus ring on keyboard focus only; hover is a separate state.

a11y.rule: Focus indicator >= 2px and >= 3:1 contrast against the surface behind it
